text.content:
Where things get made, and the suburb built to feed them.

Region: Night City, east. Districts: Arroyo (M) and Rancho Coronado (N)
Controlled by: Corporate site security inside the fences; 6th Street on the streets, with the Valentinos pushing in
The feel of it: Factories, rail yards and identical tract houses falling apart
Notable locations: Arasaka Industrial Park, East Bay Terminal, Night City Prison, Red Dirt, the Forlorn Hope, the Armory; NC Psychiatric Health, Rancho Coronado High, Tripple Xtreme, the Commons
Danger: Moderate / Corporate in Arroyo; Moderate / Combat in Rancho Coronado

If it's made in Night City, it's made in Santo Domingo. Arroyo is the factory belt of plants, docks, depots and the rail terminal; Rancho Coronado is the company suburb built to house the people who work in them, and it's already falling apart. Between them runs the 6th Street protection racket, and the war with the Valentinos along the Heywood line.

Doc Mags, who runs a clinic here, counts the same three things every night: industrial accidents, gunshots, and kids who chipped in too young.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.19; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.11
